notes.title: REC story
notes.content:
[h1]A bit of history[/h1]
REC was born as an idea for a 5v5 headcam style game, a project that I developed at the end of 2023, this little project was supposed to be paid since we were in a bad economic situation and I wanted to earn something to help my father, unfortunately my mother's alcohol abuse was pushing us further and further down so I couldn't use assets like I currently do but I could only use my head, unfortunately the computer got a very powerful malware and I had to reset the computer, a few months I started working on a new idea that could have involved more, a bodycam style campaign, then I started working on that, initially REC was supposed to be a police HORROR (main idea) but the idea was discarded for the second time, I deleted the files, May 21, 2024 I turned 18, with the little money I got from my birthday I bought Bodycam FPS Kit V2 (now V3), to have an improvement in gameplay, the following month I started the first developments in the REC engine, despite the economic problems by now past, I had to restrict the costs a bit because I lived with two sisters and only my father, this limited me a lot for a while, since the economic problems were over and by now I had bought a STEAM app, I felt forced by myself to make a game, so REC became what you know today, an FPS with a totally fantasy plot that instead of generating controversy should teach that not everything that seems good to us is actually good, but this is not connected to Ukraine, Ukraine is just an example of fantasy, that said I hope I have removed some of your curiosity and I wish you a nice day, here cat_anon I pass and close.

notes.title: 1000 wishlists! DEMO updated!!!
notes.content:
Graphical bugs have been improved and several items have been complained to here via YT videos or reviews, the game now has enhanced playability, and the bodycam ON/OFF feature has been implemented to allow even non-bodycam game lovers to play it with complete peace of mind! The optimizations have improved but it still remains to be stressed that the game is very heavy on its own and was not created for GTX1080, so I ask you to please read the minimum requirements and not to enter the discord server to ask for lower graphics.
The delay of the update happened because of problems with the school facility the I go to, it became more complicated for me to share the study with my world.
a patreon has been created as well where you can donate to advance REC development faster.
By winter theme in the map it will snow, unfortunately not enough money to buy 3D models of snow covered trees/plants so unfortunately it will remain the normal forest around the facility the DEMO is based on.
I emphasize that the game is not finished and changes and implementations may come in the future.

Thank you very much for your support!
cat_anon

notes.title: I will explain one thing.
notes.content:
[b]REC IS NOT PROPAGANDA[/b], REC is a project made by an Italian who is totally neutral towards war, war is a terrible thing but that's not why you can't make movies TV series and games about it, everyone loves action games and choosing a distorted theme is not wrong, so if you are fanatic about Ukraine and support it wholeheartedly [b]DON'T BOTHER ME, IT'S JUST A GAME.[/b]
I will say it for the millionth and last time.
REC is just a game created by an Italian, programmed in his spare time, REC is not the subject of propaganda, if you think russia must win you are wrong, if you think ukraine must win you are wrong, war is always wrong and every wrong method of support makes people in high places rich and increases the duration and deaths, wars should not harm civilians, neither Russians nor Ukrainians, I hope the war will end with a peace treaty and I do [b]NOT [/b]want Russia to win, I want everyone to return to normal, because seeing such scenes caused by politicians waging war on who has the missile that goes the farthest is not fun.
Summary
WAR IN GENERAL IS WRONG, I AM NEUTRAL ABOUT THE CURRENT WAR AND REC IS NOT FRUIT OF PROPAGANDA BUT A SIMPLE HOBBY.
I am dyslexic and cannot explain myself so I hope you understand what I have said. And not in spite of all the nastiness and the broken finger I had to medicate I will continue to work. IF YOU ARE FANATICAL, DON'T PLAY REC.
DEMO
The demo is a PROTOTYPE! It will be updated soon to improve many aspects, although there will be several improvements it will not be the last. It is recommended to wait before reviewing. unless you have a more general review.

notes.title: Demo is here. 700 wishlists!!!
notes.content:
700 wishlists! Demo bootable on November 6!
Hello all gamers, I'm cat_anon and I'm happy to announce the release of the demo in version 15.10.2024, the uploaded version is an old version due to some complications on the development due to the transition between BodycamFPSkitV2 and BodycamFPSkitV3, despite everything the version is quite updated and contains enough material, any kind of feedback, positive or negative, will be gladly accepted!
On November 6, 2024 the DEMO version of REC will be officially available, for any doubts or requests you can join the Discord server of ByteSquadGames (home page).
Thank you for keeping the project alive.<3

notes.title: 500 WISHLISTS!!!
notes.content:
[h1]500 wishlists reached! REC is getting more and more popular and I will do my best not to disappoint any of you!
UPDATES[/h1]
[h3]A fan map of unrecord is being developed! The ending and the decorations will be totally different out of respect for a small company that inspired this great project.
For the confusions REC will be SINGLEPLAYER ONLY but I am working on a possible multiplayer that will have a different visual style in honor of my first shooter project.
New weapons have been purchased.[/h3]
[h1]DEMO[/h1]
[h3]I am working on a demo that will possibly be released this month, I will do my best to keep the DEMO updated.
In the demo you will play the soldier who discovered the Ukrainian uranium stockpiles to cause a nuclear war.
The demo contains only one mission and the weight is about 6/7GB.
It will be possible to use the DualSense wireless Controller (PS5).
That's all for now and I recommend telling your friends that the demo will be released this month![/h3]

notes.title: We exceeded expectations... but I have to do
notes.content:
REC is a project that I had in mind since I was little, the project of a distorted world that shows that not always those we believe are good and that not always what seems bad is bad, I always wanted to send this message but I never had the way, I also thank a 3D modeler and WEB developer for helping me with the development of a new 3D Russian gun to add to the game, but even if everything is going well for a single person who manages everything, I will work much less this year, I am in my fifth year of high school and I am only 18 years old, this year I have to take the final exam and it will be very demanding, so I will spend a good part of it studying.

[h1][b]!!!I WILL NOT ABANDON THE PROJECT!!![/b][/h1]
The project will continue to be developed at a lower frequency and a short playable DEMO will soon be available where we will incorporate the soldier at the exact moment of discovery, I will continue to fund the game and get my hands on it in my free time which will be little, but better than nothing, being a very large project I need more ram which I will buy soon, thank you very much for the support and I recommend you also enter the discord server for any questions or requests!

notes.title: 300 wishlists... WOW
notes.content:
Hi, I'm cat_anon, I'm the only developer of REC, no one is working for me or with me, [b]I'm developing everything on my own[/b] (I'm underlining this because I noticed a bit of confusion), I'm amazed to have seen the 300 wishlists, your support brings me hope for me and for anyone who wants to make their dream come true, no matter how many problems you have, every dream of yours can come true with the right commitment and I'm proof of that, I'm not here to give the usual thanks, but I'm here to hug you all for supporting me so far and keeping me company on this hard journey, for any request or question you can join the discord server or simply create a discussion on steam, if you have requests to join the development team I'm sorry to tell you that for now I don't need employees, also because I wouldn't have how to pay them, but if you want to do it for passion, start developing on your own, it's not a bad idea, I started like this, a big hug and have a beautiful day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44943560/b5d4ca268733988c5cddadbe4390a38dce41957a.png[/img]

notes.title: 200+ wishlists!
notes.content:
200+ wishlists!
I don't know how to thank you! REC is taking a good turn in development, but I don't think it will be finished by this year, every single click on the wishlist is a huge motivation to continue working hard on this project. 

Stay tuned, there are many surprises to come. This is just the beginning!

A big thank you to all of you who believe in REC!

I would like to point out that I am the only one in the development team, so it will take a long time.
